name: IndexPro – URL Indexing Manager
author: chekkutech

sections.description:
IndexPro WordPress plugin allows you to seamlessly integrate your WordPress site with IndexPro’s URL indexing service.

Features

  • Submit URLs for indexing
  • Check indexing status
  • Bulk operations (up to 50 URLs)
  • Auto-submit new posts/pages
  • Real-time credit tracking

Use Cases

  • Get new posts indexed faster
  • Monitor indexing status
  • Bulk submit old content
  • Automate indexing workflow

External Services

This plugin connects to the IndexPro API service to submit URLs for indexing and check their indexing status. The service is required for the plugin to function.

What data is sent:
– Your website URLs (post/page permalinks)
– Your IndexPro API key (for authentication)
– Batch names (timestamps for tracking submissions)

When data is sent:
– When you manually submit URLs for indexing
– When you check the indexing status of URLs
– When auto-submit is enabled and you publish new posts/pages
– When you use bulk operations

Service provider: IndexPro (https://indexpro.app)

API endpoint: https://gpot-server.vercel.app/api

Important legal information:
– Terms of Service: https://www.indexpro.app/terms-of-service
– Privacy Policy: https://www.indexpro.app/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you agree to share your website URLs with the IndexPro service. No personal user data or content is transmitted – only the URLs you choose to submit.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/indexpro
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to IndexPro → Settings
  4. Enter your API key from IndexPro dashboard
  5. Click “Test Connection” to verify
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

Sign up at https://www.indexpro.app/index-urls and get your API key from the dashboard.

How much do operations cost?

  • Submit URL: 20 credits per URL
  • Check status: 5 credit per URL

What’s the maximum URLs I can process at once?

50 URLs for both submit and check operations.
